user.title: Roborock Obstacle Photos
user.description: Saves the obstacle and pet photos your Roborock takes to the media folder. Uses your existing Roborock integration; nothing to configure.

abort.no_roborock: Set up the Roborock integration first.

init.title: Photo options
init.description: Choose which obstacles to save and show, and how long to keep photos. Photos still on the robot's current map are never deleted. 0 days keeps photos forever.

mark_path.name: Mark path
mark_path.description: Remember how far along the robot's driven path is now, so path_crossed can later tell what it drove after this moment.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the mark, e.g. litter_box.

job.name: Job
job.description: Identifies the current or last cleaning job, e.g. its start time. A different job at check time means all of its path counts.

vacuum.name: Vacuum
vacuum.description: Vacuum name or DUID; defaults to the first.

path_crossed.name: Path crossed
path_crossed.description: Whether the robot drove through a rectangle since a mark. Returns crossed, points_checked and marked.

name.name: Name
name.description: Name of the mark to check from.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Rectangle as [x1, y1, x2, y2] in map coordinates (as used by app_zoned_clean).

job.name: Job
job.description: The current or last job, same format as when marking.

vacuum.name: Vacuum
vacuum.description: Vacuum name or DUID; defaults to the first.
